provenance.caveat: This validates the report-only extended resolver against a frozen selected study set; it is not production validation or evidence about unseen seed populations.

firstCrossingParity.definition: inputs, old winner and time, causal witness projection, every integer-tick returned interpolation through the old first-crossing tick plus the exact terminal frame, causal event records with only post-stop recovery/end copies normalized away, opportunity records, keyed draw keys, draw counts, and terminal-step ordering

returnedTrajectoryPrefix.definition: Compare actual interpolateSnapshot output for all integer ticks through each historical resolution.ticks and the exact historical terminal tick, across progress/lateral/heading/speed/x/y for every entrant; this independently checks renderer input and cannot be satisfied by firstCrossingWitness alone.
